cues.en: In the previous video I introduced you to lists in Python and I introduced you to the concept of indexing
cues.zh: 上一段介紹 Python 串列，以及用索引，

cues.en: a single item in a list and also indexing multiple items at the list which is also called slicing. Indexing
cues.zh: 取得單一項目，也介紹一次取得多個項目，也就是切片。索引，

cues.en: and slicing is a pretty important concept in Python and programming in general and so I thought I'd
cues.zh: 和切片對 Python，以及一般程式設計都很重要，所以想，

cues.en: spend just a few more minutes going through the concept of indexing and slicing again just to drive the point home a little bit further and give you a bit more experience with it.
cues.zh: 再花幾分鐘複習，加深印象，多一些操作經驗。

cues.en: So let's start by creating a vector.
cues.zh: 先建立向量。

cues.en: Now in this case, I'm going to create this vector as a range and let's say we want this range of numbers to go from 10 to 20.
cues.zh: 這次用 range，假設數字從 10 到 20，

cues.en: So that means in the range function we actually type 10 comma 21.
cues.zh: range 裡實際要寫 10、21。

cues.en: And now if I just look at what this variable vec, it is simply a range.
cues.zh: 查看 vec 變數，只是一個 range，

cues.en: So this is basically just what I typed in.
cues.zh: 基本上就是輸入的內容。

cues.en: And in fact if I would type the type.
cues.zh: 如果呼叫 type，

cues.en: Now this is not the verb to type, this is the function type which returns the class of this variable.
cues.zh: 這不是「打字」的動詞，而是傳回變數類別的 type 函數，

cues.en: And it is a class range.
cues.zh: 類別是 range。

cues.en: And if I want to convert this into a list, which I showed you in the previous video then you can use the function list and the input will be a range.
cues.zh: 要轉成串列，如上一段示範，可以用 list，輸入這個 range，

cues.en: And essentially that's going to convert the variable from the range 10 to 20 to the list of numbers from 10 to 20.
cues.zh: 把 10 到 20 的範圍，轉成包含 10 到 20 數字的串列。

cues.en: So now you can see that this variable is now of type list, and if we just look to see what that list
cues.zh: 現在型別是 list，再看看串列，

cues.en: contains, it is the integers 10 through 20 separated by commas and surrounded by square brackets.
cues.zh: 內容就是 10 到 20 的整數，逗號隔開，外面有中括號，

cues.en: So that's how you know that it's a list.
cues.zh: 這樣就知道它是串列。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now if we want to access an individual item within this vector, this variable Vec, this list, you also do that with square brackets just like this.
cues.zh: 要取得這個向量、vec、串列的個別項目，一樣用中括號。

cues.en: So for example if I want to access the first element keeping in mind that Python starts counting at
cues.zh: 例如第一個，記住 Python 從，

cues.en: zero, then you type Vec 0 and then you get the answer of 10 and that's the correct result because 10
cues.zh: 0 開始，寫 vec[0]，得到 10，正確，因為 10，

cues.en: is the first element or the element number is 0 in this list.
cues.zh: 是第一個元素，也就是串列的第 0 號。

cues.en: So if you wanted to access the number 13, which number would you have to put here? So to access 13 it's
cues.zh: 要取得 13，這裡要填多少？13，

cues.en: actually the fourth element in this list, which means the index would be 0 1 2 3.
cues.zh: 其實是第四個元素，索引是 0、1、2、3，

cues.en: So this turns out to be the third, or index element number three, and that gives us the number 13.
cues.zh: 因此是第 3 號索引，得到數字 13。

cues.en: Now if I wanted to access 12 13 and 14 how would we do that?
So there we use the colon operator.
cues.zh: 使用冒號，

cues.en: And essentially what you want to do is specify the first element here and then one plus the last element after the colon. So to access 12 13 and 14.
cues.zh: 前面指定第一個索引，冒號後指定最後索引加 1。要取 12、13、14，

cues.en: The first element that would go to the left of this colon here is the 0 1 2 element 2 or index 2 and
cues.zh: 冒號左邊，是 0、1、2，索引 2，

cues.en: then to get to 14, it's 2 3 4 and then you have to go one more to 5.
cues.zh: 再來到 14，是 2、3、4，還得多加一，到 5。

cues.en: So this returns 12 13 and 14.
And this procedure here, this is called slicing, because we are taking a slice out of this list.
cues.zh: 這個程序叫切片，因為從串列裡取一片。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So a couple of other things you can do if you wanted to get from let's say element 5.
cues.zh: 還有幾種做法，例如從索引 5，

cues.en: Up until the end.
cues.zh: 一直到最後，

cues.en: So now I'm not writing anything after the colon I just leave the colon as it is.
cues.zh: 冒號後不寫任何東西，保留冒號，

cues.en: And that's going to return 0 1 2 3 4 5.
So element 5.
cues.zh: 第 5 號索引開始。

cues.en: And again you have to be a bit careful here because this is the way you know the way that like normal humans would count.
cues.zh: 要小心，一般人平常的計數方式，

cues.en: This is the first second third fourth fifth sixth element but Python starts counting at 0.
cues.zh: 是第一、第二、第三、第四、第五、第六，但 Python 從 0 開始，

cues.en: So that's index number five.
cues.zh: 所以這裡是索引 5，

cues.en: And it goes all the way up to the end and that's what this notation means.
cues.zh: 一路到最後，這就是語法的意思。

cues.en: So based on this syntax, I'm sure you can guess how the syntax would look like if we wanted to go from the beginning up to and including the number 15.
cues.zh: 依照這個語法，相信你能猜到，如果要從開頭，到包含 15，該怎麼寫。

cues.en: So how would you do that?
cues.zh: 怎麼做？

cues.en: So keeping in mind that when you specify the top index you always do one plus the number that you want.
cues.zh: 記得，上界索引一定比你想要的最後索引多 1，

cues.en: So this will be index 0 1 2 3 4 5 6.
So here we would write nothing.
cues.zh: 前面不寫，

cues.en: And then colon six.
cues.zh: 接冒號、6，

cues.en: And that gives us the numbers 10 through 15.
So up to this element here.
cues.zh: 到這個元素為止。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: The next thing I'm going to show you is how to count backwards or how to index backwards from the end towards the beginning.
cues.zh: 接著示範倒著數，或從結尾往開頭反向索引。

cues.en: So I already showed you how to access the first element, so that would be zero or if you want the second element then its index number one.
cues.zh: 前面示範，第一個用 0，第二個用索引 1，

cues.en: What would you do if you wanted the last index in this array, in this vector?
cues.zh: 要這個陣列、向量最後的元素呢？

cues.en: Now you could figure out what is the size of this list and say it's element number 0 1 2 3 4 and so on but that's not always such a scalable method.
cues.zh: 可以先算串列大小，數 0、1、2、3、4，依此類推，但不一定方便擴充。

cues.en: So the way to automatically get to the very end of a list is to use minus one.
cues.zh: 自動取得串列最後的方法，是 -1。

cues.en: So you say minus one and the way to think about this is that it's like you're starting here at zero and imagine that when you go to negative indices you're wrapping around to the end.
cues.zh: 可以想成，從 0 出發，負索引就繞到結尾，

cues.en: So this is the index number two index number one index number zero and then index minus 1 is wrapping all the way around and we get to the end.
cues.zh: 這是索引 2、1、0，再來 -1，就繞到最後，

cues.en: So index minus 1 corresponds to 20.
cues.zh: 所以索引 -1 對應 20，

cues.en: And that also means that index minus 2 is going to be 19.
cues.zh: 也代表 -2 對應 19。

cues.en: So that's actually pretty handy.
cues.zh: 很方便，

cues.en: We can access the second to last element, which is also called the penultimate element, by using minus two.
cues.zh: 用 -2 取得倒數第二個，也就是 penultimate element，

cues.en: And this is handy because we don't need to know exactly how many elements there are in this list for this procedure to work.
cues.zh: 不必確切知道串列有幾個元素，仍能運作。

cues.en: Now if you wanted to flip this list around and count backwards from the end to the beginning there's a little bit of a funny notation here.
cues.zh: 如果想把整份串列反轉，從尾到頭數，有個有趣記法，

cues.en: Essentially you go colon colon and then minus one.
cues.zh: 就是兩個冒號，再接 -1，

cues.en: So why is this the right thing to do?
cues.zh: 為什麼這樣寫正確？

cues.en: Why does this make sense? To explain this, I'm going to introduce you to something called skipping.
cues.zh: 為什麼合理？先介紹跳著取值。

cues.en: So let's say we wanted to go from the first element of this list to... I don't know how about the number 14.
cues.zh: 假設要從第一個，到例如數字 14，

cues.en: So let's say we want to count from 10 to 14.
cues.zh: 也就是 10 到 14，

cues.en: So that's no problem.
cues.zh: 沒有問題，

cues.en: You already know how to do that.
cues.zh: 你已經知道怎麼做，

cues.en: You can say 0 2 and then it's the element or index 0 1 2 3 4.
OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that gives... oops, you can see this confusing I already just made a mistake :P
cues.zh: 哎，可以看到很容易混淆，我也剛犯錯了。

cues.en: So this gives us the indices 0 through 4 which corresponds to the numbers 10 through 14.
cues.zh: 這樣取索引 0 到 4，對應 10 到 14。

cues.en: Now let's say that I only wanted to skip every other number, so I don't want the eleven and I don't want the 13.
cues.zh: 如果想隔一個取一個，不要 11，也不要 13，

cues.en: I want to go from 10 to 14 but skipping in steps of two.
cues.zh: 從 10 到 14，每次跨 2，

cues.en: So the way to do that is you add another semicolon here and you tell Python here after the second semicolon how much you want to skip by.
cues.zh: 再加一個冒號，在第二個冒號後，告訴 Python 要跨多少。

cues.en: So this is saying we skip by two. So now this returns 10 12 14 and this is not just about counting even numbers; you could say three.
cues.zh: 這裡跨 2，得到 10、12、14。不只能取偶數，也能設成 3，

cues.en: And now you're counting in steps of three.
cues.zh: 每次跨 3，

cues.en: So it goes from index zero and then one two three.
And then well then we go up to this number but there's no more steps of three that go after this so it stops at 13.
cues.zh: 一直到上限，但沒有下一個跨 3 的位置，所以停在 13。

cues.en: So now let's try for example if I would type colon colon three.
cues.zh: 試試只寫兩個冒號，再 3，

cues.en: Now this is going to return the first element or basically it returns all the elements skipping in three.
cues.zh: 基本上會傳回從第一個開始，每隔三個索引取得的元素，

cues.en: So we get this.
cues.zh: 得到這樣，

cues.en: And then one two three one two three one two three.
cues.zh: 一、二、三，一、二、三，一、二、三，

cues.en: And then it gets to the end.
cues.zh: 最後到結尾。

cues.en: So the colon Colon is actually just a shorthand for writing zero.
cues.zh: 兩個冒號基本上是省略開頭的 0，

cues.en: And then to the end in steps of three.
cues.zh: 再一路到最後，每次跨 3 的簡寫。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So with that in mind, we can also count from the beginning to the end of the sequence in steps of two.
cues.zh: 同樣也能從頭到尾，每次跨 2，

cues.en: We can go from the beginning to the end of the sequence in steps of 1 and now in this case.
cues.zh: 或每次跨 1，這種情況，

cues.en: You know this is extra text but just to show you that that works.
cues.zh: 只是多寫，但示範它確實能用。

cues.en: So now when I write minus one what I'm actually doing is going from the beginning to the end but I'm skipping in steps of minus one.
cues.zh: 所以寫 -1，實際上就是走訪整個序列，但步長為 -1，

cues.en: And that's how you get the list flipped backwards.
cues.zh: 這樣就把串列反轉了。

cues.en: So I hope this makes sense, and I hope you see that indexing and slicing and Python is not really so fundamentally difficult.
cues.zh: 希望你理解，也看出 Python 的索引、切片，其實沒那麼難。

cues.en: There are a few little tricks and shortcuts that you have to remember, but don't stress yourself out about trying to memorize these. As you go throughout your programming,
cues.zh: 有些小技巧、簡寫要記，但不用勉強死背。隨著寫程式，

cues.en: you will naturally become more and more familiar with this and eventually it will become second nature.
cues.zh: 自然會越來越熟悉，最後變成直覺。

cues.en: The main thing that you have to be mindful of is the fact that Python starts indexing at 0.
cues.zh: 最重要的，是記得 Python 從 0 起算索引，

cues.en: So that can sometimes cause a little bit of confusion and you have to be careful with that.
cues.zh: 這有時會造成混淆，需要留意。
